title: DS@GT ARC at CheckThat! 2026: A Verdict-Anchored Pipeline for Generating Fact-Checking Articles
abstract: arXiv:2611.05382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Our code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkth

translated_title: DS@GT ARC 团队参加 CheckThat! 2026：一种以裁定为锚点的事实核查文章生成流水线
translated_abstract: 错误信息的传播速度远超专业事实核查员手动验证并撰写文章解释其裁定的速度，因此需要自动化生成事实核查文章。本文详细介绍了 DS@GT ARC 团队在 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! 实验室任务3（事实核查文章生成）中所做的工作。我们的目标是从一个声明、其原始裁定以及一组抓取的源文档出发，生成完整的事实核查文章。我们团队构建了一个四阶段流水线：清洗噪声证据、检索并聚类相关来源、通过以原始事实核查员裁定为条件约束 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 模型来生成文章，并通过确定性后处理恢复行内引用。我们取得了 0.428 的平均分，在 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! 实验室任务3的 9 支队伍中排名第三，而基线的平均分为 0.272。我们的代码已在 GitHub 上发布：https://github.com/dsgt-arc/checkth
tldr: 该论文提出了一种以事实核查员原始裁定为锚点的四阶段流水线，通过清洗证据、检索聚类来源、基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 条件化生成文章并用确定性后处理恢复引用，实现了事实核查文章的自动化生成，在 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! 任务3中以 0.428 的平均分获得 9 支队伍中的第三名。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a four-stage verdict-anchored pipeline—cleaning noisy evidence, retrieving and clustering sources, generating articles by conditioning Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovering inline citations via deterministic post-processing—to automate fact-checking article generation, achieving a mean score of 0.428 and ranking 3rd out of 9 teams in CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 3.
